verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Tax Calculations and Transactions APIs, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. llms.txt and Markdown docs are LLM-friendly documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
